[[File:Matt Duncan portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Matt Duncan.]]
'''Matt Duncan''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 101 from Gardendale, Al. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> At DecipherCon 1999 Duncan also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing 42nd in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
